tspan.tspan: 为什么伊斯兰迫害女性？

text.tspan: 伊斯兰 在历史上并非总是压抑女性，有女性在政治、经
济、教育 方面担当重任。这跟中国传统的女性地位也有
相似（eg. 缠足习俗），甚至跟西方也差不多
基本上，大部分古代社会都重男轻女。既然白人可以从
野蛮走向进步，我们有色人种也可以
举例来说，阿富汗 年轻女性在 1970s 年代是这样的：她
们穿短裙、上大学读书
一个国家 落后，通常有两种原因：一是 位置偏远，文明
传播不到（现在已经很少这种情况），二是因为 殖民主
义的蹂躏（eg 中东、中国、印度、非洲、南美）
大约在二战前后，英国 和 俄罗斯 开始发现并争夺在 中东
的 石油，后来 美国 加入，即我们熟悉的 美-苏 冷战。 在
这争夺过程中，当地国家遭到 严重破坏，包括 政治、经
济、技术和文化上
当 知识分子 被消灭，剩下愚昧的人民 转向 宗教极端 和
恐怖主义，就像一个被 性侵 的少女，她不努力于康复，
而陷入了 自暴自弃 和 自残 (self-multilation). 这是一种
丧失理智 的行为
第三世界被西方 霸凌，不学习进步而 返回祖先的落后，
这个现象不是 伊斯兰 特有。 正如 八国联军 侵华时，产
生了 义和拳「刀枪不入」的妄想症
Islam has not always been a society that oppresses women;
women have played important roles in politics, economics,
and education. This is similar to the traditional status of
women in China (eg. foot binding), and even the West is
similar
Basically, most ancient societies favored men over women.
Since white people could progress from barbarism to
enlightenment, so can people of color
For example, this is what young Afghan women looked like
in the 1970s: they wore short skirts and went to university
A country's backwardness usually stems from two causes:
#1: its remoteness prevents the spread of civilization (this is
rare nowadays); #2: the devastation of colonialism (e.g., the
Middle East, China, India, Africa, and South America)
Around the time of World War II, Britain and Russia began
discovering and competing for oil in the Middle East, later
joined by USA, ie the Cold War. During this contest, local
countries suffered severe damage -- political, economic,
technological, and cultural
Third World countries, bullied by the West, regress to
ancient backwardness instead of learning and progressing.
This is not unique to Islam. The Boxers Rebellion during
Western invasion of China developed a delusion that they
were immune to bullets
China and Russia also suffered from irrationality in the
form of communism -- a delusion born of a thirst for
revenge against the more advanced and prosperous West
When the intelligensia are eliminated, the remaining
ignorant masses turn to religious extremism and terrorism,
much like a sexually abused girl who, instead of striving for
recovery, falls into self-destruction and self-multilation. A
spiral towards irrationality
中国 和 俄罗斯 其实仍非常 守旧，而 共产主义 本身也是
一种 错误的、因 复仇心切 而脱离现实的妄想
